deploymentEvidence.bindingExplanation: Official table places sUSDai on Arbitrum hub, distinct from Ethereum/Base/Plasma OFTs. Blockscout current implementation metadata identifies StakedUSDai implementation. Sourcify proxyResolution false is retained literally and is not relied on to classify as nonproxy; proxy ABI/compilation and Blockscout establish proxy.

abiEvidence.limitation: Reported Sourcify match (not exact_match) for implementation. Immutable USDai binding and linked library addresses are source-service onchain transformation evidence, not a fresh runtime or storage attestation.

lifecycleEvidence.decision: Admit actual Arbitrum sUSDai vault ordinary deposits and asynchronous redemption request/claim methods. Official Oct 2 2026 recap describes funded GPU loans, sUSDai distribution and ongoing GLX development; current docs explain cash-constrained FIFO epochs. No retirement or exit-only context identified in reviewed sources.
lifecycleEvidence.metrics: Official $659M+ TVL is protocol-level marketing, not claimed vault TVL or DAU. No numeric activity metric used for admission.

sourceSemantics.staking: Three deposit overloads and two user mint overloads transfer USDai and mint sUSDai using real implementation _deposit/_mint. minShares/maxAmount overloads protect conversion; referral merely logs event. _update checks msg.sender/from/to blacklist.
sourceSemantics.redemption: requestRedeem(shares,controller,owner) burns sUSDai, authenticates owner or existing operator, checks controller blacklist, queues request via bound RedemptionLogic library. Request minimum 1e18 shares and max 50 active per controller. Thirty-day global epochs derive from immutable genesis; privileged STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE serviceRedemptions services available cash FIFO. withdraw/redeem consume serviced controller requests, not wallet shares or immediate generic ERC4626 exits.
sourceSemantics.disabledPreviews: previewWithdraw and previewRedeem unconditionally revert DisabledImplementation. They remain in complete ABI but are excluded.
sourceSemantics.ownership: No generic share allowance is substituted for _validateOperator: caller must equal account or already be in isOperator mapping. setOperator is retained but unadmitted authorization management.
sourceSemantics.scope: No USDai base mint/redeem, bridge OFT, adapter, arbitrary multicall, loan callbacks, strategy manager or loan markets admitted.

selectedFunctions.label: USDai Stake USDai with share bound and referral
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity or successful-execution guarantee. Balances, allowances, pauses, canonical calldata, grants and independent execution checks remain mandatory; zero native value for all admitted calls.

Arbitrum hub sUSDai TransparentUpgradeableProxy 0x0B2b2B2076d95dda7817e785989fE353fe955ef9; Blockscout reports implementation 0x4637193852dF85b7Ac05DD052B187460D81551f6. Sourcify proxyResolution incorrectly/insufficiently reports isProxy false despite proxy compilation; binding uses Blockscout implementation metadata, not that negative result.

Underlying asset is Arbitrum USDai; Ethereum/Base/Plasma token deployments are OFT representations and are not user vault targets here. Deposits mint sUSDai at optimistic valuation; direct deposit/mint variants have no caller slippage bound. Overloads with minShares/maxAmount add explicit price limits; referral overload only records a referral code.

requestRedeem burns shares immediately into an asynchronous FIFO request for controller; caller must be owner or an already approved operator. Minimum request is 1e18 shares and at most 50 active requests per controller. No cancel-request function exists in the reviewed ABI.

withdraw/redeem are claim methods against already serviced controller requests, not instant unstaking. Caller must be controller or existing operator; servicing is STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE-only, cash-constrained and epoch-based, with potential partial fulfillment and multi-epoch delay. Request shares do not guarantee prompt USDai liquidity.

Pause and USDai blacklist restrictions apply; controller eligibility is checked explicitly and underlying transfers/share _update remain subject to blacklist checks. Deposits/mints are ordinary user calls, but do not bypass USDai legal, sanctions or transfer restrictions. No operator grants, permit, bridge mint/burn, multicall or loan callbacks admitted.
